purpose: Execution-only sharding of the already-frozen formal fixed-T_st qualification. It changes no species, geometry, seeds, synthetic worlds, estimand, null family, centering, thresholds, p-value rule, or biological interpretation.

authority.formal_execution: may use sharded execution only after a frozen screen result has status PASS_TO_FORMAL_FIXED_TST_QUALIFICATION

invariants.center_definition: For each amplitude, use the same 199 worlds in replicate order 0..198 and the same np.sum(T_st, axis=1)/199 operation; then equal-weight the four amplitude means.
invariants.inference: same least-favourable one-sided Monte Carlo max-p envelope

center.rationale: 199 < frozen execution batch size 200, therefore each center cell is computed as the same single matrix batch as the monolithic runner.

reference.aggregation: concatenate beta_G arrays in increasing replicate-index order

evaluation.aggregation: concatenate beta_G arrays in increasing replicate-index order before envelope p-values

positive.aggregation: concatenate beta_G arrays in increasing replicate-index order before envelope p-values

exactness_checks: every shard derives seeds from the frozen master seed, namespace, cell label, and original replicate index
center cell summation preserves the monolithic single-batch operation
reference/evaluation/positive beta arrays are concatenated in original replicate order
a reduced-world test fixture must compare sharded and monolithic outputs before the formal workflow is used

gate.private: Wilson 95% upper rejection-rate bound <=0.10 in every A cell

forbidden: change shard boundaries after inspecting any formal synthetic result
drop or rerun a shard based on its beta distribution except for byte-identical technical retry
mix screen worlds into formal worlds
change world_batch_size as a scientific tuning parameter
open genetic response during sharded formal qualification
